snippet.title: Devil's Drizzle - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035880/Devils_Drizzle/

Devil's Drizzle Indie Game

A Brazilian indie pixel art platformer, launching in early 2025. It combines the challenge of Celeste with the charm of Adventure Time.

Demo available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035880/Devils_Drizzle/

Devil's Drizzle is a 2D platformer that narrates the story of a kid in pursuit of his friend, an umbrella. Brave the storm and outrun the clutches of the demonic Pazuzu in this audacious effort to save your buddy.

#indiegame #kickstartergames
